newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ s/adj unemployment rises to 6.4 pct at March 31.
newsitem.headline: NZ s/adj unemployment rises to 6.4 pct at March 31.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand on Tuesday issued the following provisional, seasonally-adjusted data for March quarter employment and unemployment.
Figures are based on standard international definitions with "revised from" figures in brackets.
Note- Expectations were for an unemployment rate of 6.15 percent, quarterly employment growth of 0.35 percent for an annual growth rate of 1.72 percent and a participation rate of 65.78 percent.
